content:
Years ago, a number of strange UFO sightings were captured on camera but never received much attention from the mainstream media. Apart from a handful of dedicated UFO websites and online communities, many of these cases remained largely unnoticed. 


Today, it may be worth taking another look at some of that older footage, recordings made long before AI-generated imagery became widespread. 

Strange lights. Unidentified objects. Mysterious shapes appearing in the sky. 

In this video, we take a closer look at several intriguing cases: 

• The Metapod UFO hovering over Spain 

• A cylindrical UFO spotted over the sea 

• A glowing orb appearing above a playground in Finland 

• A pyramid-shaped object observed in the night sky over Brazil 

• Fiery objects descending over Tijuana 

Some of these recordings may have ordinary explanations. Others remain difficult to identify. 

But all of them were captured before the age of AI, and that makes them worth examining again.
